question: In relation to the attempt to access Primary Refresh Token (PRT), can you identify the name of the process involved in this activity?
answer: BrowserCore.exe (browsercore.exe) — the process used to request the user's Primary Refresh Token (PRT). It was spawned by powershell.exe running get-userprttoken.ps1, which was launched via WMI by WmiPrvSE.exe.
